svg.title: Early save
svg.text: Wind up close in and the computer goalie drops early (Genesis)
To scale, top net. A slapshot wound up within 60 units of the goal line, goalie near the middle: he pad-stacks before the shot.
slides to the middle and past
Only when bit 1 of the seconds left is clear: 2 game seconds on, 2 off (0.8 s of real time each).
